math.task: A baker packs 9 boxes with 7 muffins in each box. How many muffins are there altogether?
Lena shares 56 stickers equally among 8 friends. How many stickers does each friend get?
A farmer collects 50 eggs. He packs them in boxes of 6. How many eggs are left over?
Tom has 15 marbles. He buys 3 bags with 6 marbles in each bag. How many marbles does he have now?
5 notebooks cost 20 dollars. How much do 8 notebooks cost?
A shirt costs 40 dollars. There is 25 percent off. What is 25 percent of 40 dollars?
A crate is 4 cm long, 5 cm wide and 3 cm high. How many cubic cm are inside the crate?
3 eggs make 6 pancakes. How many eggs do you need for 12 pancakes?
There are 6 bags with 9 beads in each bag. Mia takes 6 bags and gives away 5 beads. How many beads does Mia have now?
Ana scored 84 points on Monday and 96 points on Tuesday. What is her average score?
A classroom has 4 rows with 6 desks in each row. 5 desks are broken. How many whole desks are there?
A train goes 70 km in one hour. How many km does it go in 4 hours?

language.task: Tom has 5 apples. He gives 2 apples to Ana. How many apples does Tom have now?
Mia has 8 pears. Ana has 3 pears. Ana gives Mia 4 more pears. How many pears does Mia have now?
Sam has 6 balls. He finds 3 more balls. He gives 4 balls to his friend. How many balls does Sam have now?
Lily has 10 stickers. Her brother has 6 stickers. How many more stickers does Lily have than her brother?
Ben has 7 toy cars. His sister takes 2 of his cars. How many cars does Ben have left?
There are 12 birds in a tree. 5 birds fly away. 3 more birds come. How many birds are in the tree now?
Zoe has 9 marbles. She puts 3 marbles in a box. She puts 2 more marbles in the box. How many marbles are in the box?
Raj has 11 pencils. He breaks 2 pencils. How many whole pencils does Raj have now?
Ana and Mia pick apples. Ana picks 7 apples. Mia picks 5 apples. They put all the apples in one basket. How many apples are in the basket?
Tom has 4 red balls and 3 green balls. How many balls does Tom have altogether?
A farmer has 15 cows. He buys 6 more cows. He sells 4 cows. How many cows does the farmer have now?
Ella has 20 beads. She gives 5 beads to Sam and 3 beads to Ana. How many beads does Ella have left?

code.task: There are 315 people. Each bus holds 40 people. How many buses are needed?
A shop made 96 dollars. It shares the money equally among 8 workers. How much does each worker get?
A game hero has 45 health. He loses 18 health. How much health is left?
A player scores 150 points. A bonus adds 60 points. What is the total score?
A box holds 120 marbles. 35 marbles are taken out. How many marbles are in the box now?
A level needs 200 coins. You have 145 coins. How many more coins do you need?
plan: total = 6*7; total = total - 2
plan: score = 10; if score > 5 then score = score + 5 else score = score - 5
plan: counter = 0; for i from 1 to 4 do counter = counter + 3
plan: n = 3*4; if n > 10 then for i from 1 to 2 do n = n + n else n = n - 1
plan: health = 100; if health > 50 and health < 150 then health = health - 30 else health = health + 10
plan: a = 2*9; b = a + 6; b/3
